children: Armata Pharmaceuticals received $3.7 million in additional non-dilutive funding from the U.S. Department of War to support Phase 3 development of AP-SA02.
Received $3.7M in additional non-dilutive DoW funding specifically to support Phase 3 execution for AP-SA02.
This increment brings cumulative DoW support for the AP-SA02 program to approximately $32.4M.
Funding was awarded via MTEC and managed by NMRC/NAMD with Defense Health Agency and Joint Warfighter Medical Research Program support.
AP-SA02 is being developed as an adjunctive IV treatment for complicated Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia (MSSA and MRSA); funds will support the Phase 3 program.
